currentFocus.title: Design the Browser SQL execution and scheduler contract

stageSummary.completed: bootstrap, scope-definition, current-state-audit, requirements-consolidation, browser-constraints, official-capability-research, target-architecture, relational-data-model, ingest-enrichment-atomicity

baselineSource.result: V1 remains the frozen verified reference for browser collection and integrity behavior.

ingestEnrichmentAtomicity.result: Selected immutable complete-cycle handoff, defensive SQL-authority validation, one logical bulk cycle operation, set-based SQL enrichment and one atomic transaction that advances cycle/snapshot/current_universe/latest/session state together.
ingestEnrichmentAtomicity.temporalRule: For horizon H choose the latest same-security snapshot with collected_at_ms <= current.collected_at_ms - H*1000; otherwise NULL.
ingestEnrichmentAtomicity.bulkDirection: Arrow/equivalent single bulk relation per cycle; no per-security DB RPC contract.
ingestEnrichmentAtomicity.dealsDelta: Remains NULL/unpopulated until reset/trading-day semantics of DailyDealsQuantity are explicitly verified.

githubExecutionRequirement.rule: The planning project must end with real executable GitHub Issues and, where supported/useful, milestones, labels and dependency/parent-child structure. Markdown planning alone is not the final deliverable.
githubExecutionRequirement.plannedPhases: P implementation decomposition, Q GitHub execution structure, R final plan audit

verification.specImpact: No runtime code or current implementation spec changed. Phase G defines target planning contracts only.

next.action: Planning Phase H: design the SQL execution and scheduler contract.
steps: Define active query identity/version and deterministic activation semantics.
Define read-only analytical SQL boundary and separation from admin/schema SQL.
Choose scheduler clock semantics independently from collection cadence.
Define query failure state versus latest successful result.
Define result materialization/safety behavior and cancellation/timeout handling under currently verified DuckDB-Wasm capabilities.

history.rule: Superseded architecture/research plans remain cold history and do not carry current progress.
